title: SONGPAL FACTORY (175)
style: happy hardcore, 175 BPM, instrumental with chipmunk-pitched vocal chops only (no lead vocal, no rap), supersaw stack detuned wide, hoover bass stabs, four-on-the-floor pounding kick, factory/conveyor-belt motifs, claps on offbeat, mechanical filter sweeps, sidechain pumping everything to the kick, playful euphoric uplift, festival mainstage 2026 production, no profanity, no real-artist references
lyrics:
[Intro — 0:00 — pads, conveyor-belt clank, sub swell, faint kick pulse]
(chop, +6) "Songpal — Factory"
(chop, +6) "Track — by — track"
(chop, +6) "Save — on — the — fly"
(chop, +6) "Mansion — production"

[Build — 0:16 — hoover roll, riser, snare 4/8/16/32, mechanical filter sweep]
(chant, up) "Songpal — Songpal — Songpal — Songpal"
(chant, down) "Mansion — open — the — line"
(chant, up) "Finich — not — finish"
(riser hold)

[Drop 1 — 0:32 — full hardcore, supersaws wide, kick fours, claps offbeat]
(stacked) "SONGPAL — FACTORY!"
(call) "TRACK — BY — TRACK!"
(stacked) "SAVE — ON — THE — FLY!"
(call) "MANSION — PRODUCTION!"
(stacked) "FINICH — NOT — FINISH!"

[Verse — 1:04 — half-time, piano + saw stabs, conveyor clank]
(chop run) "Line — one — running"
(chop run) "Line — two — shipped"
(chop run) "Keel — on — the — floor"
(chop run) "G4 — Lens — checking"
(chop run) "Track — by — track — by — track"

[Breakdown — 1:36 — strip to piano + lone chop, no kick]
(chop, slow, +8) "Three..."
(chop) "Three..."
(chop) "Six..."
(chop, fading) "Mansion — open"
(riser, white noise, snare roll)

[Drop 2 — 2:00 — double-time, full euphoria, layered chops]
(wall) "SONGPAL — FACTORY — 175!"
(wall) "SAVE — ON — THE — FLY!"
(wall) "G4 — LENS — ON!"
(wall) "FINICH — NOT — FINISH!"
(wall) "TRACK — BY — TRACK — TONIGHT!"

[Outro — 2:32 — fade on chop + sub]
(chop, fading, +6) "Songpal Factory..."
(chop, fading) "Save on the fly..."
(chop, fading) "Mansion open..."
(sub pulse out)
